purpose: Define the missing field bridge for C without inventing coupled evidence from the direct target or nuisance channels.

required_outputs.coupled_response_score: positive evidence that the focal biological target/flower exhibited the predeclared local response pattern
required_outputs.target_link_confidence: independent evidence that the response is attributable to the focal actor/interaction rather than arbitrary local motion

hard_independence_rules: coupled_response_score cannot be copied from PolliPi direct target evidence
target_link_confidence cannot be copied from PolliPi direct target evidence
neither coupled field quantity may be defined as 1 - nuisance
nuisance truth cannot be used as a runtime input to create positive coupled evidence
known biological truth is annotation/calibration-only and cannot be consumed at held-out runtime
runtime_combination: usable coupled target route = coupled_response_score * target_link_confidence
freeze_requirements: predeclare the primary-stream measurement used for local target response
freeze any parameters or thresholds from development-only data
verify no target/nuisance/truth leakage in runtime inputs
register the final artifact SHA-256 before held-out scoring
claim_boundary: Until frozen, C may remain absent from a field implementation or be treated as development-only; no indirect-rescue field claim is authorized.
